import { chromium } from 'playwright'
const b = await chromium.launch()
const out = process.env.HOME + '/dvwork/shots/'
for (const [name, vp] of [['desktop',{width:1440,height:900}],['mobile',{width:390,height:844}]]) {
  const ctx = await b.newContext({ viewport: vp })
  const p = await ctx.newPage()
  const errs = []
  p.on('pageerror', e => errs.push(e.message))
  p.on('console', m => { if (m.type()==='error') errs.push(m.text()) })
  await p.goto('http://localhost:4173/', { waitUntil: 'networkidle' })

  // keyboard: tab to first stage and arrow through
  await p.locator('[data-stage="mainspring"]').focus()
  await p.keyboard.press('ArrowDown'); await p.keyboard.press('ArrowDown')
  await p.waitForTimeout(800)
  await p.screenshot({ path: out + `j-${name}-keyboard.png` })
  const lit = await p.locator('.stage.is-active .stage__name').innerText()

  // hover a layer slab
  await p.locator('[data-layer="main"]').scrollIntoViewIfNeeded()
  await p.locator('[data-layer="main"]').hover()
  await p.waitForTimeout(500)
  await p.screenshot({ path: out + `j-${name}-layer.png` })

  // choose a finish, fill, submit
  await p.locator('[data-config="skeleton"]').scrollIntoViewIfNeeded()
  await p.locator('[data-config="skeleton"] input').check()
  await p.waitForTimeout(500)
  await p.screenshot({ path: out + `j-${name}-chosen.png` })
  await p.fill('#name', 'M. Perrin')
  await p.fill('#email', 'perrin@example.ch')
  await p.click('button[type="submit"]')
  await p.waitForTimeout(700)
  await p.locator('.record').scrollIntoViewIfNeeded()
  await p.waitForTimeout(400)
  await p.screenshot({ path: out + `j-${name}-record.png` })
  const rec = await p.locator('.record').innerText()
  console.log('---', name, '| active after arrows:', lit.replace(/\n/g,' '))
  console.log(rec.replace(/\n+/g, ' | '))
  console.log('errors:', errs.length ? errs.join(' /// ') : 'none')
  await ctx.close()
}
// reduced motion
const ctx = await b.newContext({ viewport: {width:1440,height:900}, reducedMotion: 'reduce' })
const p = await ctx.newPage()
await p.goto('http://localhost:4173/', { waitUntil: 'networkidle' })
await p.evaluate(() => window.scrollTo(0, 2600)); await p.waitForTimeout(600)
await p.screenshot({ path: out + 'j-reduced.png' })
console.log('reduced-motion captured')
await b.close()
EOF

{
  "schemaVersion": 1,
  "status": "current",
  "productPurpose": "Product page for Caliber 08, a manual-winding mechanical movement by Aubry & Vent made in a run of 200. Read at length by collectors who care how a movement is built and how it runs, then used to reserve one of three finishes.",
  "creativeFingerprint": {
    "premise": "The movement is a path energy travels through in a fixed order, so the page is a specimen sheet of that plate: the drawing is introduced in outline, then lit and traced stage by stage as the reader moves through the six stages of the power path.",
    "composition": "Warm drawing paper for every reading section, broken once by a single dark lit band that holds the schematic. Asymmetric hero: type stack left, plate drawing right inside a drafting grid, title block beneath. Sticky plan against a scrolling stage list.",
    "typeVoice": "Instrument Serif display, IBM Plex Sans body, IBM Plex Mono for every figure and micro-label. Tabular numerals throughout. Nothing meaningful under 12px.",
    "materialAndMedia": "Two temperatures: German-silver-warm paper (#f2eee5) against a cool steel band (#15181b). Gilt (#a3762f / #e2a94e) is reserved for energy and allocation and appears nowhere else. Focal object is a drawn SVG plan of the movement, not fabricated photorealism. One sourced CC0 photograph of Le Brassus for the workshop band; Lucide marks on the workshop facts.",
    "motionAndInteraction": "Ambient layer everywhere: 130/190/340ms, one hover grammar. Signature is the power path traced through the plan, advancing fractionally with scroll rather than snapping; the escapement stage shows a 2.5Hz beat. Layer stack explodes on hover/focus.",
    "continuity": "The same plate drawing appears twice and evolves: unlit outline with dimensions in the hero, lit and populated with the traced path in the power-path band. A numbered mono eyebrow (01-06) with a gilt rule runs the length of the route."
  },
  "protectedContracts": [
    "Six power-path stages in energy order, each with its detail line and figure",
    "Four layers with thicknesses and notes (0.9 + 1.4 + 0.8 + 0.7 = the stated 3.8mm height)",
    "All ten specification rows",
    "Three finishes with exact CHF prices, delivery dates, remaining allocation",
    "Five workshop facts including the run of 200 and indefinite servicing",
    "Reservation form and confirmation naming finish, price, delivery date",
    "Reservations are not binding and no payment is taken"
  ],
  "runtimeOwners": {
    "scroll": "native scroll, rAF-throttled listener in PowerPath computes stage + fraction from geometry",
    "animation": "CSS transitions and one keyframe; no motion runtime installed",
    "spatial": "none"
  },
  "importantAssets": [
    {
      "path": "src/assets/vallee-de-joux.jpg",
      "role": "Workshop band field. Le Brassus, Vallee de Joux. Wikimedia Commons, author Shev123, CC0. Credited in the figcaption.",
      "status": "available"
    }
  ],
  "testedStates": [
    { "route": "/", "viewport": "1440x900", "checks": ["full page", "power-path trace at all six stages", "layer explode hover and focus", "finish selection", "form submit and confirmation", "keyboard arrow stepping", "console clean"] },
    { "route": "/", "viewport": "390x844", "checks": ["full page", "sticky schematic across the stage list", "finish selection", "form submit and confirmation", "no horizontal overflow"] },
    { "route": "/", "viewport": "320x720", "checks": ["full page", "no horizontal overflow", "title bar single line", "spec sheet stacked form"] },
    { "route": "/", "viewport": "390x844 reduced-motion", "checks": ["no text collision", "static end states"] }
  ],
  "deliberateDecisions": [
    { "decision": "The focal object is a drawn schematic, not a photograph or a CSS-fabricated movement.", "reason": "No truthful photograph of Caliber 08 exists, and a stock photo of another maker's movement would be a fabricated claim. A plan view is honestly a drawing, and it is the form this audience already reads." },
    { "decision": "Global scroll-behavior: smooth removed.", "reason": "It animated every programmatic scroll and fought the scroll-linked trace; anchor targets now use scroll-margin-top instead." },
    { "decision": "Scroll reveals are written as a data attribute, not a class.", "reason": "React owns className on the finish cards and wiped the revealed state on re-render, making the selected card vanish." },
    { "decision": "The finish chooser is a radio-card group rather than a select.", "reason": "Three options the buyer needs to compare on price, date and remaining allocation; a native select hides all of that behind one line." },
    { "decision": "The spec sheet is a table; the workshop facts are not.", "reason": "Specifications are compared across a fixed set of values, so alignment does the work. Five prose facts in a card grid would be undifferentiated density." }
  ],
  "outstandingVisualIssues": []
}
